description: This PHP source file defines the CampaignROIChartDashlet class, which extends DashletGenericChart to generate a dashboard chart for campaign ROI in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for displaying options, constructing data queries, and preparing chart data, with embedded JavaScript for rendering a bar chart using RGraph.

classes.name: CampaignROIChartDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard chart dashlet class for displaying campaign ROI metrics in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Generates options for selecting campaigns, populating the campaign_id search field.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Constructs chart data based on selected campaign and renders a JavaScript-based bar chart.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds data queries to retrieve campaign-related metrics such as total value, revenue, investment, budget, and expected revenue.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares and formats data for chart rendering, including labels and values.
